briefing.name: briefing
briefing.textSnippet: The whole class is building one adventure today. It is set in this school after the bell has gone: everybody has gone home, the doors are still open, and odd things happen. Each of you writes ONE room
briefing.contentAnchor: The whole class is building one adventure today. It is set in this school after the bell has gone: everybody has gone home, the doors are still open, and odd things happen. Each of you writes ONE room — a place in the school, one question, and two roads the player can take. When your room is finished, it joins the class's adventure, and you can play it, going through rooms your classmates wrote.
briefing.cardText: J2 · LESSON 4 OF 17 · Today your program chooses what happens next. · Every program you have written so far runs its lines in order, from the top to the bottom, and it does the same thing every time. Today you write a program that CHOOSES. It reads what the player typed, and then it decides which lines to run. · You are going to build a text adventure.
